Matla Gene Engineering (MG Engineering) is a South African firm founded on the legacy of master craftsman Eugene Pienaar. Delivering electrical, mechanical, and renewable energy solutions across Africa, creating efficient, sustainable, and turnkey projects for residential, commercial, and industrial clients.

PRECISION

Micron-level accuracy.

RESILIENCE

Industrial-grade uptime.

OUR VISION

"To be a globally trusted provider of sustainable engineering solutions, powering homes, industries, and cities through innovation and integrity."

OUR MISSION

"To deliver world-class electrical and mechanical systems that are reliable, efficient, and tailored to evolving international standards - enabling energy security and infrastructure resilience worldwide."

MG Engineering (“we,” “our,” “us”) values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit our website www.matlag.co.za.

01
INFORMATION WE COLLECT

We may collect the following information when you interact with our website:

PERSONAL INFORMATION
Name, email address, phone number, and other details you provide via contact forms or newsletter sign-ups.
TECHNICAL DATA
IP address, browser type, device information, operating system, and pages visited on our website.
COOKIES AND TRACKING DATA
We use cookies to improve your browsing experience and gather analytical data about website usage.
02
HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION

We use the data we collect for the following purposes:

To respond to inquiries and provide requested services.
To send updates, newsletters, or marketing communications (where consent is given).
To improve website functionality and user experience.
To comply with legal obligations.
03
SHARING YOUR INFORMATION

MG Engineering does not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your data with:

SERVICE PROVIDERS
Third-party companies that assist with website hosting, email communication, or analytics.
LEGAL AUTHORITIES
When required by law or to protect our legal rights.
04
COOKIES AND TRACKING

Our website may use cookies to enhance user experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect some website functionality.

05
DATA SECURITY

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

06
YOUR RIGHTS

You have the right to:

Request access to the personal data we hold about you.
Correct or update your personal information.
Request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal requirements.
Withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time.

To exercise your rights, please contact us via the contact form.

07
THIRD-PARTY LINKS

Our website may contain links to external sites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those websites.

08
CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted on this page with the effective date revised.
